landing_page.subtitle: Real results.
landing_page.slogan: Edumock.uz quality education with your quality app
landing_page.description: Edumock.uz is an educational platform contributing to the development of training centers in Uzbekistan, which fully undertakes the organization of the Speaking part of CEFR exams in training centers and guarantees students quality preparation.

trust_section.guaranteed_desc: We ensure high standards for organizing the Speaking part.
trust_section.collaborative_desc: We contribute to developing the educational ecosystem together.
trust_section.localized_desc: Built specifically for the needs of Uzbekistan's training centers.

landing_page.guest_mode_welcome: Welcome, Guest! You are in a trial mode. Your progress will not be saved.
landing_page.hero_desc: Let your students speak from preparation, not from nerves, on exam day. The official CEFR structure, strict timers, screen recording and a cloud archive — in one platform.
landing_page.how_title: Start to finish — the rhythm of a real exam.
landing_page.how_desc: The test follows the CEFR Speaking structure: four parts, fixed timers, questions read aloud. Each session is recorded from start to finish.
landing_page.step_desc_1: Question bank, timed parts, screen recording and cloud storage.
landing_page.step_desc_2: Center-level mock exams with unified evaluation.
landing_page.step_desc_3: Personal mock exams for students with feedback.
landing_page.feat_record_desc: The whole session — screen, camera and system audio — is recorded in the browser and kept locally. Upload it to EduCloud to open it from any device.
landing_page.feat_questions_desc: Add and edit questions for every part. The app tracks when a question was last used so students don't get the same one twice.
landing_page.pricing_desc: Pick a plan that fits your center. Longer plans include bigger EduCloud storage and priority support.
landing_page.cta_title: Start preparing for the next exam today.
landing_page.cta_desc: Start in guest mode right now — no registration. Need a full account for your center? One message is enough.
landing_page.hero_note: Works in the browser. Google Chrome on a desktop is recommended for screen recording.
landing_page.mock_question: Talk about a place you like to visit.
landing_page.flow_note: Timings are the ones used by the app. Part 1.2 gives 45 s for the first question and 30 s for the rest.
landing_page.feat_questions_p1: Sub-questions for Part 1.1 and 1.2, one per line
landing_page.feat_questions_p2: Up to two images per question
landing_page.feat_record_p1: Student ID, name and phone attached to every recording
landing_page.feat_record_p2: Local copy plus cloud copy, delete either one
landing_page.feat_record_p3: Storage limit depends on your plan
landing_page.roadmap_desc: Edumock.uz is live for training centers. The next stages extend it to center-wide exams and individual students.
landing_page.faq_desc: Short answers to what training centers ask most often.
landing_page.faq_q1: Can I try it without registering?
landing_page.faq_a1: Yes. Guest mode opens the full test flow with sample questions. Recordings stay in your browser; cloud upload and adding your own questions need an account.
landing_page.faq_q5: How do I pay for a plan?
landing_page.faq_a5: Pick a plan in the Pricing section and contact us on Telegram — we activate the account and set the EduCloud limit for your center.
landing_page.footer_tagline: CEFR Speaking platform for training centers
landing_page.benefits_desc: Students learn to speak under real exam pressure — and you see every answer and point out mistakes precisely.
landing_page.b1_desc: Four parts, real time limits, spoken questions — exactly like CEFR Speaking.
landing_page.b2_desc: Screen, camera and audio. Students hear themselves; teachers give precise feedback.
landing_page.b3_desc: Add unlimited questions with images. The app prevents repeats.
landing_page.b4_desc: Recordings live in EduCloud and open from any device.
landing_page.band_desc: The whole session — screen, camera and system audio — is recorded in the browser and kept locally. Upload it to EduCloud to open it from any device and review it with the student.
landing_page.q_title: Your own questions for every part.
landing_page.guarantee_desc: Guest mode is free with no time limit. Choose a plan only once you're convinced.

guide_dialog.title: Guide
guide_dialog.description: Important instructions for proper application usage:
guide_dialog.rule1_text: Your recorded videos are saved locally in your browser's storage. This means they are only accessible from the browser you used to record (e.g., Google Chrome). Use the same browser to access your local records.
guide_dialog.rule2_text: To prevent accidental loss of your recordings due to clearing browser history, cache, or cookies, it is highly recommended to upload your videos to cloud storage as soon as possible after the test.
guide_dialog.rule3_text: When starting the test, select 'Entire Screen' in the pop-up window, check the 'Also share system audio' box, and click the 'Share' button. The exam will start after this.
